_about: A model of an Activator item. object says which eventstream it reads, the column that identifies each object, and its properties. Each rule has a property, a condition (kind "each event" for a stateless comparison, "becomes" for a change of state, or "no data" for a heartbeat) and an action.
needs: Each freezer is watched on its own; a store has many freezers.
When a freezer's TempC rises above -15, post once to the store operations Teams channel, and start the Log incident pipeline. Don't post again for every reading while it stays warm.
If a freezer sends nothing for 10 minutes, email maintenance@contoso.example.
